course.title: Bachelor of Science | UNSW Sydney
quotes: Tailor the Bachelor of Science around your interests with 28 majors across the physical, natural and human sciences.
Entry scores are calculated from the best three or four A2 subjects (excluding repeated subjects) using the following values: A*=6, A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=1.
Biology & Biodiversity Study life science and explore how organisms function, grow, evolve and relate to their environment.
Molecular and Cell Biology Study cell biology, which explores molecular structures, cellular processes, and their roles in function, reproduction and development.
2026 Indicative first year full fee $61,000* 2026 Indicative full fee to complete degree $194,000*

Indicative fees to complete the degree/program include tuition plus an estimate of study-related costs of approximately $1,000 per year and have been calculated based on percentage increase for every year of the degree/program

program.summary: Bachelor of Science (UAC 429000, program 3970), 3 years. One degree with 28 majors; life-science majors include Biology & Biodiversity and Molecular and Cell Biology.

costs.note: International, 2026 indicative: $61,000 for the first year and $194,000 for the whole degree (UNSW says the whole-degree figure includes about $1,000 a year of study-related costs and yearly increases). Shown as the whole-degree fee spread over 3 years.

admissions.threshold: Bachelor of Science: A-level score of 10.0 from the best three or four A2 subjects (A*=6, A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=1). This is the score that got an offer in 2026, a guide only.
Bachelor of Science: IB Diploma 31.0. This is the score that got an offer in 2026, a guide only.
